0 headline groups await editorial review. Matching headlines do not establish coordinated reporting or confirm the same event.

New links arrive automatically. Assessments need review.

  1. Approved feeds supply unchanged headlines, source links, authors and publication dates. Each source has a recorded reuse policy.
  2. Canonical links and hashes remove exact duplicates. Missing dates, future dates, failed retrievals and out-of-scope hosts are excluded.
  3. The latest index retains 30 days of metadata; daily metadata archives are saved separately. Similar headlines form provisional groups; they do not establish the same event or political blindspots.
  4. A separate article-analysis queue uses permitted text and a capped daily AI allowance. Check its connection and progress in the live status section. Collection itself makes no model calls. Editors must approve full comparisons and translations before editorial publication.
  5. Feed health, source timestamps and unchanged-language headlines remain visible. The five-item official daily brief is a separate selection.
